description_en: Creates a subscription task for custom operational reports
name: CreateDcdnSubTask

parameters.help_en:
The list of report IDs that support customization. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Valid values:
2: Popular URLs (sorted by request count).
4: Popular URLs (sorted by traffic).
6: Popular referers (sorted by request count).
8: Popular referers (sorted by traffic).
10: Popular back-to-origin URLs (sorted by request count).
12: Popular back-to-origin URLs (sorted by traffic).
14: Top client IP addresses (sorted by request count).
16: Top client IP addresses (sorted by traffic).
18: Domain name ranking (sorted by traffic).
20: PVs and UVs.
22: Access region distribution.
24: ISP distribution.
26: IPv4/IPv6 peak bandwidth.
27: Back-to-origin bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
支持定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
2：热门URL（按请求数排序）。
4：热门URL（按流量排序）。
6：热门Referer（按请求数排序）。
8：热门Referer（按流量排序）。
10：回源热门URL（按请求数排序）。
12：回源热门URL（按流量排序）。
14：Top客户端IP（按请求数排序）。
16：Top客户端IP（按流量排序）。
18：域名排行（按流量排序）。
20：PV和UV。
22：访问区域分布。
24：运营商分布。
26：IPv4/IPv6峰值带宽。
27：回源带宽
parameters.name: report_ids

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The list of domain names to be subscribed to. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can subscribe to a maximum of 500 domain names. To subscribe to more than 500 domain names, submit an application (https://page.aliyun.com/form/act2017566026/index.htm).</props>

<props="intl">The list of domain names to be subscribed to. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can subscribe to a maximum of 500 domain names. To subscribe to more than 500 domain names, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex).</props>
If you do not specify this parameter, the report delivery task is subscribed for all domain names within your account by default
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请填写信息 (https://page.aliyun.com/form/act2017566026/index.htm)申请。</props>

<props="intl">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex)申请。</props>
不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务
parameters.name: domain_name
